prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the input paint_mask_guide.png in place as a texture painting atlas. Output ONE transparent RGBA PNG at 1536x2048 (3:4). The guide is the authoritative geometry/layout: three columns and FOUR rows of square cells. Preserve every object's exact position, scale, silhouette, gaps and orientation. Do not enlarge tiny end-on views. First two rows have five views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty; lower two rows repeat these exact silhouettes. The design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is the original colour reference (ignore magenta background). Paint ONLY the existing grey silhouettes.
TOP HALF rows 1-2: unlit base colour painting of MM9 Crude Spear in MM6-MM8 inventory style: broad asymmetric pale steel leaf/flame point, copper collar, long simple reddish-brown wood shaft, crossed ochre leather upper bindings and two loose narrow leather tails. Extrapolate materials faithfully onto all views; no added ornament. Facets and surface details follow reference scaled to each view. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, aura, outlines, text or ground.
BOTTOM HALF rows 3-4: same five silhouettes as FLAT material classification masks, pure colours ONLY: #FF0000 every metal part including blade and copper collar; #00FF00 leather bindings and loose tails or fur; #0000FF cloth/cord/ribbon/hair if any; #FFFF00 wood shaft and other matte nonmetal solids; #000000 gemstone/glass if any. No shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Every silhouette pixel receives exactly one appropriate pure colour. Nothing outside silhouettes. Both empty cells (column 3 rows 2 and 4) remain transparent. Keep all guide openings fully transparent. Do not redraw, move, redesign, or enlarge objects. This is the complete atlas, not a single enlarged spear illustration.
